## Narrow Screens

Make this window narrower than 768 pixels, or open the page on a phone.
A button with the title of the table of contents appears at the bottom of the page.
Select it to open the table of contents in a sheet.

## Current Section

The sheet highlights the section you are reading.
Select a heading in the sheet to close it and go to that section.

### Nested Headings

Headings below the first level show under their parent.

## Turn It Off

Set `toc: false` in the front matter of a page, and the page has no button.

## Documentation

See <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-mobile-toc/> for the styling properties and the close label.
